tools.name: shorten_url
tools.description: Create a gajo.io short link for a URL and return it as shortUrl. Links follow your plan's code length and lifetime and count against its monthly quota. Pro plans can pass customCode for a branded gajo.io/c/{code} link, or shorten app deep links (myapp://...) with a web fallbackUrl.

tools.name: list_urls
tools.description: List your short links, newest first, with click counts. Returns one page; use page to see more.

tools.name: get_url
tools.description: Look up one of your short links: destination, click count, status, and expiry.

tools.name: get_url_stats
tools.description: Click analytics for one of your links, bots excluded: total clicks and clicks per day. Basic and Pro also get referrers, devices, countries, and regions.

tools.name: update_url
tools.description: Pro only: point an existing short link at a new destination URL. Takes effect immediately.

tools.name: deactivate_url
tools.description: Turn off one of your short links so it stops redirecting. Generated codes are never reassigned.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Your plan, links created this month, links remaining, and API rate limit.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_url" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "get_url_stats" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
